event:
I submitted the verdict: the finding stands. The assertion `mci_error_non_fatal_warm_rst_check` only prints its "SVA ERROR" message when it is violated. I found nothing in the repository that turns that message into a test failure, so the stability requirement is reported but not enforced.

I didn't check whether the simulator's own assertion-failure count feeds into pass/fail. The suggested fix is to add `$error(...)` to the else action, or to have the regression log scanner treat "SVA ERROR" as a failure.

The verdict has been accepted and I'm done.
